sentences.text: Shri Amit D ubey, learned counsel for the applicant.
Shri Amit Pandey, learned Panel Law yer for the respon dent/ State.
Heard on the question of admission.
Having peruse d the impugned judgm ent and memo of revision, this revision being arguable is admitted for final hearing.
Learned Panel Law yer has accepted the notice of admissi on of this revision on behalf of the respon dent/ State.
Hence, no further notice is required to be sent to it.

Also heard on I.A. No.1 51 9 5/ 20 1 5 , w hich is the first application under Section 3 97 (1 ) of the Cr.P.C moved on behalf of the applicant for suspen sion of sentence and grant of bail during the pendency of this revision.

Vide the impugne d judgment dated 31 .0 7 .2 0 15 passe d by the Sixth Additional Sessions Judge,
Sagar in Criminal Appeal No.4 4 4/ 2 01 5 Nemichand V s. State of M.P. through F ood I nspector, D epartment of F ood and Drug Administration, Sagar, D istrict Sagar, the applicant stands convicted under Sections 7 (1 )/ 1 6( 1 ) ( a)( 1 ) of the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 19 54 and sentenced thereunder to suffer R.I . for one year w ith a fine of R s.1 00 0/ - with default clause.

entities.text: Nemichand V s. State of M.P.
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant remained on bail during the trial of the case and pendency of the appeal.

How ever, he has been suffering jail sentence since 3 1.07 .20 1 5,
the date of impugne d judg ment.
I t is also submitted by him that the applicant had already deposited the fine amount and he never misuse d the liberty granted by the trial Court and the appellate Court by releasing him on bail.
I t is also submitted by him that this revision is of the year 20 15 and there is no likelihood of this revision being heard on merits in recent future.
I t is also submitted by him that looking to the short jail sentence this revision beco mes infructuous, in case the applicant w ould have suffered the jail sentence before hearing of it on merits.
Upon these submi ssion s, learned counsel prays to allow the I.A. Learned Panel Law yer oppos es the prayer.

Considerin g the facts and circumstance s of the case, the submission s advanced on behalf of the parties by their counsel and the short term of jail sentence, but w ithout expressin g any opinion on merits of the case, I am of the view that it is a fit case for suspen sion of jail sentence and grant of bail to the applicant, therefore, the I .A. is allow ed.
The execution of remaining jail sentence of the applicant is hereby suspende d

and it is ordered that he shall be released on bail subject to depositing fine, if any, and on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of R s.4 0 ,0 00 /- (rup ees f ort y thous and onl y) w ith one solvent surety of the same amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court.
On being released on bail, the applicant shall appear before the R egistry of this Court first time on 0 3.1 1.2 01 5 and thereafter on all such dates as may be fixed by it in this regard until further orders of this Court.
